import random, importlib.util
from fractions import Fraction
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
rng=random.Random(4)

def frac_score(vecs_int, thr):
    """vecs_int: list of ((n0,n1,n2), den) in query direction."""
    exact=[(Fraction(n,den) for n in nums) for nums,den in vecs_int]
    best=None; wit=0
    for i in range(len(exact)-1):
        U=exact[i][0]; D=exact[i+1][2]
        v=U+D-U*D
        if best is None or v<best: best=v; wit=i
    fl=[(float(a),float(b),float(c)) for a,b,c in exact]
    return float(best), main.full_score(fl), wit, best<thr

def make_vec(bits):
    den=rng.getrandbits(bits)+1
    nums=tuple(rng.randrange(den+1) for _ in range(3))
    tot=sum(nums)
    if tot==0: nums=(den,0,0)
    return main.normalize_vector(nums, den)

bad=0
for trial in range(4000):
    n=rng.randint(2,20)
    bits=rng.choice([30,200,600,1900])
    vecs=[make_vec(bits) for _ in range(n)]
    a=rng.randint(0,1000000); b=rng.randint(max(a,1),1000000)
    thr=Fraction(a,b)
    lookup_key={}
    keys=[]
    for i,v in enumerate(vecs):
        keys.append((i,i+1))
    def lookup(k, vecs=vecs, keys=keys):
        return vecs[keys.index(k)]
    path=list(range(1,n+2))
    got=main.score_query(path, a, b, lookup)
    exp=frac_score(vecs, thr)
    if abs(got[0]-exp[0])>1e-12 or abs(got[1]-exp[1])>1e-12*max(1,abs(exp[1])) or got[2]!=exp[2] or got[3]!=exp[3]:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH", n, bits); print(got); print(exp); break
print("score trials done, bad", bad)
